adds.title: Dark Phoenix
adds.text: Charles sends Peter with the X-Men to rescue the Endeavour crew in space, and Peter speeds the astronauts out of the breaking shuttle.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Speeds the astronauts out on Charles's space rescue.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Sends Peter's team to rescue the astronauts.
adds.evidence: Endeavour rescue: Charles (with Raven) commands the X-Men, Quicksilver gets most of the crew out; Peter is later hurt at the Grey house before Charles freezes everyone.

adds.title: Dark Phoenix
adds.text: Scott learns Charles hid the truth about Jean's past from her, but he stands with Charles on the train to convince the others that Jean can still be saved.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Stands with Charles to save Jean.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hid Jean's past, then fights beside Scott to save her.
adds.evidence: Plot: Xavier reveals he suppressed Jean's memories; on the train 'Xavier and Scott convince McCoy, Lehnsherr, and their allies that Jean is not beyond help.'

adds.title: Dark Phoenix
adds.text: Ororo flies on the space rescue Charles sends the X-Men on, and after Raven's death she stays with Charles and goes with him to New York to save Jean.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Stays with Charles and helps him save Jean.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Ororo's team to save Jean.
adds.evidence: Storm is on the Endeavour mission Charles commands; after Raven's death Hank leaves but the X-Men go with Xavier to New York and fight on the train.

adds.title: Dark Phoenix
adds.text: When Charles learns Erik means to kill Jean, Kurt teleports him and the X-Men to New York to save her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Teleports Charles to New York to save Jean.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Kurt's teacher, whom he takes to New York to save Jean.
adds.evidence: Plot: 'Learning of Lehnsherr's plan, Kurt Wagner teleports the X-Men to New York to save her.'

adds.title: Dark Phoenix
adds.text: Raven leads Kurt on the space rescue, sending him into the breaking shuttle to teleport the astronauts out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Teleports the astronauts out on Raven's rescue.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Kurt on the space rescue.
adds.evidence: Endeavour rescue: Raven, the field commander, has Scott blast a hole so Nightcrawler and Quicksilver can get in; Kurt teleports the crew back to the jet.

adds.title: Dark Phoenix
adds.text: Ororo flies on the space rescue Raven leads, and follows her to Jean's hometown to bring Jean home.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: On Raven's team in space and at Jean's home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Ororo's team in space and to Jean's home.
adds.evidence: Storm is among the X-Men on the Endeavour mission (commanders Xavier and Mystique) and in the skirmish at Jean's childhood home where Raven is killed.

adds.title: Dark Phoenix
adds.text: On the space rescue Scott blasts a hole in the shuttle so Kurt can teleport in, and later Kurt teleports him to New York to save Jean.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Teleports Scott to New York to save Jean.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Blasts open the shuttle for Kurt.
adds.evidence: Endeavour rescue: Raven has Cyclops fire a hole for Nightcrawler and Quicksilver; Kurt later teleports the X-Men to New York.

adds.title: Black Panther
adds.text: Ayo stands guard by Shuri at the coronation, raising her spear when M'Baku closes in on her, and later fights beside her against the Border Tribe.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The princess Ayo guards and fights beside.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Guards Shuri and fights beside her.
adds.evidence: Ayo stands beside Ramonda and Shuri, points her spear at M'Baku when he approaches Shuri, and is cornered with Shuri, Nakia and Okoye by the Border Tribe in the final battle.

adds.title: Black Panther
adds.text: Okoye leads the Dora Milaje guarding the royal family. When Killmonger takes the throne, she stays to serve it rather than flee with Ramonda and Shuri.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The queen mother Okoye stays behind rather than flee with.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The general who stays to serve the throne under Killmonger.
adds.evidence: After the duel Okoye tells Nakia she is bound to the throne no matter who sits on it, and lets Nakia, Ramonda and Shuri go into exile while she serves Killmonger.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
adds.text: Pulled into the Quantum Realm with Scott and his family, Hank is saved by his evolved ants and helps Scott and Hope fight their way to Kang.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fights through the Quantum Realm with Hank to reach Kang.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Brings his ants to help Scott reach Kang.
adds.evidence: Plot: 'After being rescued by his ants, who rapidly evolved... Hank helps Scott and Hope as they make their way to Kang.'

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
adds.text: Janet is pulled into the Quantum Realm with Scott and his family, where Scott learns her past with Kang helped him rise. In the end she fixes Kang's power core so the family can get home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fixes the power core that gets Scott's family home.
adds.evidence: Plot: the five are sucked into the Quantum Realm; Jentorra tells the Langs Janet's involvement with Kang led to his rise; Janet fixes the power core and they jump through the portal home.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
adds.text: Jimmy and Scott have lunch together, and Scott pulls a card trick with Jimmy's card. Passers-by who recognize Ant-Man pay their bill.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The friend who pulls a card trick on Jimmy over lunch.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Has lunch with Scott and falls for another card trick.
adds.evidence: Woo and Lang grab lunch; Lang does a card trick with Woo's card and passers-by who recognize Ant-Man pay their bill.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
adds.text: Loki and Mobius watch Victor Timely, another variant of Kang, present his inventions at the 1893 Chicago World's Fair.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Spots Victor Timely with Loki at the fair.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Watches Victor Timely with Mobius at the fair.
adds.evidence: Post-credits scene: Loki and Mobius encounter Victor Timely at the Chicago World's Fair in 1893.
